22247-if-you-touch-them-they-vanish.title: If You Touch Them They Vanish
22247-if-you-touch-them-they-vanish.creator: Gouverneur Morris
22247-if-you-touch-them-they-vanish.description: A book by Gouverneur Morris. Old Martha wondered if the Poor Boy would have a smile for her. He had had so many in the old days, the baby days, the growing-up days, the college days, the "world so new and all" days. There were some which she would always remember. The smile he smiled one Christmas morning, when he put the grand fur coat around her shoulders, and the kiss on her cheek.

arxiv-1412-6803.description: A 2014 arXiv research paper by Marthe Bonamy, Hervé Hocquard, Samia Kerdjoudj, André Raspaud. An incidence of an undirected graph G is a pair ( v , e ) (v,e) where v v is a vertex of G G and e e an edge of G G incident with v v .

arxiv-2109-02948.title: Critical parameters for singular perturbation reductions of chemical reaction networks
arxiv-2109-02948.creator: Elisenda Feliu
arxiv-2109-02948.description: Abstract We are concerned with polynomial ordinary differential systems that arise from modelling chemical reaction networks. For such systems, which may be of high dimension and may depend on many parameters, it is frequently of interest to obtain a reduction of dimension in certain parameter ranges.

arxiv-2110-11159.title: Each Attribute Matters: Contrastive Attention for Sentence-based Image Editing
arxiv-2110-11159.creator: Liuqing Zhao *, Fan Lyu *, Fuyuan Hu, Kaizhu Huang, Fenglei Xu, Linyan Li † \dagger
arxiv-2110-11159.description: Abstract Sentence-based Image Editing (SIE) aims to deploy natural language to edit an image. Offering potentials to reduce expensive manual editing, SIE has attracted much interest recently. However, existing methods can hardly produce accurate editing and even lead to failures in attribute editing when the query sentence is with multiple editable attributes.

arxiv-2112-11603.title: Polaron-Depleton Transition in the Yrast Excitations of a One-Dimensional Bose Gas with a Mobile Impurity
arxiv-2112-11603.creator: Mingrui Yang *, Matija Čufar, Elke Pahl, Joachim Brand
arxiv-2112-11603.description: Abstract We present exact numerical data for the lowest-energy momentum eigenstates (yrast states) of a repulsive spin impurity in a one-dimensional Bose gas using full configuration interaction quantum Monte Carlo (FCIQMC). As a stochastic extension to exact diagonalization it is well suited for the study of yrast states of a lattice-renormalized model for a quantum gas.

arxiv-2203-05702.title: Vertiport Selection in Hybrid Air-Ground Transportation Networks via Mathematical Programs with Equilibrium Constraints
arxiv-2203-05702.creator: Yue Yu, Mengyuan Wang, Mehran Mesbahi, Ufuk Topcu
arxiv-2203-05702.description: Abstract Urban air mobility is a concept that promotes aerial modes of transport in urban areas. In these areas, the location and capacity of the vertiports–where the travelers embark and disembark the aircraft–not only affect the flight delays of the aircraft, but can also aggravate the congestion of ground vehicles by creating extra ground travel demands.

arxiv-2209-07166.title: Study of q diagram in GX 339-4
arxiv-2209-07166.creator: Sanyukta Agarwal (190765), J. S. Yadav
arxiv-2209-07166.description: Abstract Black hole X-ray binary (BHXB) GX 339-4 produces the most frequent X-ray outbursts (every 2-4 years) among known X-ray binary sources in our galaxy. Here we present the study of the evolution of GX 339-4 over the years of observations using the Hardness Intensity Diagram (HID), i.e., the q diagram.

arxiv-2210-16287.title: Constraining Lepton Flavor Violating Higgs Couplings at the HL-LHC in the Vector Boson Fusion Channel
arxiv-2210-16287.creator: Rahool Kumar Barman, P. S. Bhupal Dev, Anil Thapa
arxiv-2210-16287.description: Abstract We explore the parameter space of lepton flavor violating (LFV) neutral Higgs Yukawa couplings with the muon and tau leptons that can be probed at the high-luminosity Large Hadron Collider (HL-LHC) via the vector boson fusion (VBF) Higgs production process.

arxiv-2211-16259.title: Measuring the Measuring Tools: An Automatic Evaluation of Semantic Metrics for Text Corpora
arxiv-2211-16259.creator: George Kour, Samuel Ackerman
arxiv-2211-16259.description: Abstract The ability to compare the semantic similarity between text corpora is important in a variety of natural language processing applications. However, standard methods for evaluating these metrics have yet to be established. We propose a set of automatic and interpretable measures for assessing the characteristics of corpus-level semantic similarity metrics, allowing sensible comparison of their behavior.

arxiv-2407-02639.title: Holistically-Nested Structure-Aware Graph Neural Network for Road Extraction
arxiv-2407-02639.creator: Tinghuai Wang, Guangming Wang, Kuan Eeik Tan
arxiv-2407-02639.description: Abstract Convolutional neural networks (CNN) have made significant advances in detecting roads from satellite images. However, existing CNN approaches are generally repurposed semantic segmentation architectures and suffer from the poor delineation of long and curved regions. Lack of overall road topology and structure information further deteriorates their performance on challenging remote sensing images.

arxiv-2411-09811.title: Hadronic vacuum polarization contribution to the muon g-2 on Euclidean windows from tau data
arxiv-2411-09811.creator: Pablo Roig
arxiv-2411-09811.description: Abstract We computed for the first time the τ \tau data-driven Euclidean windows for the hadronic vacuum polarization contribution to the muon g-2. We showed that τ \tau -based results agree with the available lattice window evaluations and with the full result.

arxiv-2505-09181.title: Properties of Giant Radio Galaxies larger than 3 Mpc
arxiv-2505-09181.creator: H. Andernach, M. Brüggen
arxiv-2505-09181.description: Abstract Context. Giant radio galaxies (GRG) are radio galaxies with physical sizes of their radio emission larger than 0.7 Mpc. Recently, the sample of GRGs has become large enough to study the extreme end of the GRG size distribution. Aims.

arxiv-2506-13772.title: MobiEdit : Resource-efficient Knowledge Editing for Personalized On-device LLMs
arxiv-2506-13772.creator: Zhenyan Lu, Daliang Xu, Dongqi Cai, Zexi Li, Wei Liu, Fangming Liu, Shangguang Wang, Mengwei Xu*
arxiv-2506-13772.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) are deployed on mobile devices to power killer applications such as intelligent assistants. LLMs pre-trained on general corpora often hallucinate when handling personalized or unseen queries, leading to incorrect or outdated responses. Knowledge editing addresses this by identifying and adjusting a small crucial portion of model weights, without compromising the general knowledge.

Such studies frequently assume that human cortical areas are only identifiable insofar as they resemble those measured invasively in monkeys. This is true despite the ele

pmc-10709113.title: The state‐of‐the‐art technic of stereotactic radioablation for the treatment of cardiac arrhythmias: An overview
pmc-10709113.creator: Farzad MasoudKabir, Reyhaneh Bayani, Nima Mousavi Darzikolaee, Alireza Abdshah, Mahsa Moshtaghian, Farshid Farhan, Mahdi Aghili, Ali Kazemian, Luca Nicosia, Francesco Cuccia, Ana Vitoria Rocha, Fatemeh Jafari, Filippo Alongi
pmc-10709113.description: IntroductionCardiac arrhythmias, including ventricular tachycardia (VT), stand as a significant threat to health, often leading to mortality and sudden cardiac death. While conventional treatments for VT exhibit efficacy, cases of refractory VT pose challenges. Stereotactic Arrhythmia Radioablation (STAR) offers a novel approach, delivering precise high‐dose radiation to well‐defined targets with minimal collateral damage.

pmc-11041768.title: Broad sialic acid usage amongst species D human adenovirus
pmc-11041768.creator: Rosie M Mundy, Alexander T Baker, Emily A Bates, Tabitha G Cunliffe, Alicia Teijeira-Crespo, Elise Moses, Pierre J Rizkallah, Alan L Parker
pmc-11041768.description: Human adenoviruses (HAdV) are widespread pathogens causing usually mild infections. The Species D (HAdV-D) cause gastrointestinal tract infections and epidemic keratoconjunctivitis (EKC). Despite being significant pathogens, knowledge around HAdV-D mechanism of cell infection is lacking. Sialic acid (SA) usage has been proposed as a cell infection mechanism for EKC causing HAdV-D.

pmc-11497378.title: FMRP protects breast cancer cells from ferroptosis by promoting SLC7A11 alternative splicing through interacting with hnRNPM
pmc-11497378.creator: Nan Wang, Bin Shi, Lu Ding, Xu Zhang, Xiaolan Ma, Songlin Guo, Xia Qiao, Libin Wang, Duan Ma, Jia Cao
pmc-11497378.description: Ferroptosis is a unique modality of regulated cell death that is driven by iron-dependent phospholipid peroxidation. N6-methyladenosine (m6A) RNA modification participates in varieties of cellular processes. However, it remains elusive whether m6A reader Fragile X Mental Retardation Protein (FMRP) are involved in the modulation of ferroptosis in breast cancer (BC).

pmc-11599418.title: Efficacy and safety of weekly liquid alendronate in Korean postmenopausal women with osteoporosis: a 12-month, multi-center, randomized trial
pmc-11599418.creator: Seungjin Baek, Seong Hee Ahn, Namki Hong, Da Hea Seo, Seongbin Hong, Yumie Rhee
pmc-11599418.description: SummaryThis study compared liquid and tablet forms of alendronate for osteoporosis treatment. After 12 months, both forms increased bone density to a similar degree with no significant differences in side effects. New low-volume liquid alendronate is as effective as tablets, offering an alternative treatment option for postmenopausal women with osteoporosis.

pmc-12532995.title: Protein markers of ovarian cancer and its subtypes: insights from proteome-wide Mendelian randomisation analysis
pmc-12532995.creator: Anwar Mulugeta, David Stacey, Amanda L. Lumsden, Iqbal Madakkatel, S. Hong Lee, Johanna Mäenpää, Martin K. Oehler, Elina Hyppönen
pmc-12532995.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundOvarian cancer (OC) is often diagnosed at an advanced stage when prognosis is poor. We aimed to identify blood plasma proteins predictive of OC risk.MethodsWe conducted proteome-wide Mendelian randomisation (MR) analyses using summary-level protein quantitative trait locus data covering 2337 plasma proteins, and genome-wide association data on OC and its subtypes (up to 25,509 cases) from the Ovarian Cancer Association Consortium. Wald ratio or inverse-variance weighted MR analysis was used as the primary method, depending on the number of instruments.

pmc-12595501.title: Chemical propulsion of hemozoin crystal motion in malaria parasites
pmc-12595501.creator: Erica M. Hastings, Tomasz Skora, Keith R. Carney, Henry C. Fu, Tamara C. Bidone, Paul A. Sigala
pmc-12595501.description: Malaria parasites infect red blood cells where they digest host hemoglobin and release free heme inside a lysosome-like organelle called the food vacuole. To detoxify excess heme, parasites form hemozoin crystals that rapidly tumble inside this compartment. Hemozoin formation is critical for parasite survival and central to antimalarial drug activity.

pmc-13312657.title: Spatiotemporal single-cell atlas of suture stem cell dynamics in craniosynostosis
pmc-13312657.creator: Xinyan Chen, Chenzhi Lai, Tian He, Zong Chen, Xiaolei Jin
pmc-13312657.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundCraniosynostosis is a congenital disorder characterized by premature suture fusion and aberrant skull morphogenesis. The cellular dynamics and regulatory mechanisms of suture mesenchymal stem cells (SuSCs) in this disease remain poorly defined.MethodsWe integrated single-cell RNA sequencing and 2-μm-resolution Visium HD spatial transcriptomics to build a spatiotemporal atlas of coronal suture cells in Fgfr2C342Y/+ mice, a murine model recapitulating human Crouzon syndrome, alongside wild-type controls across three key developmental stages (E14.5, E18.5, and P3).

pmc-13400426.title: Development and characterization of starch films functionalized by Oxalis triangularis anthocyanins and Chenpi essential oil Pickering emulsion for beef preservation
pmc-13400426.creator: Gang Liu, Tingting Liu, Changxing Jiang
pmc-13400426.description: In this work, we prepared an antibacterial film using potato starch (PS) incorporated with Oxalis triangularis anthocyanin (OA) and Chenpi essential oil Pickering emulsion (PE) stabilized by PS and nano titanium oxide (NT) and applied them for preservation of beef. The PE-PS-NT100 emulsion showed excellent stability with a 209.6 nm particle size and a 43.

pmc-13445850.title: Effectiveness without safety: a response to Duggan, Hardy, and Waller (2026)
pmc-13445850.creator: Laurence Cobbaert
pmc-13445850.description: This commentary responds to Duggan, Hardy, and Waller’s systematic review and meta-analysis of cognitive-behavioural therapy (CBT) for outpatients with anorexia nervosa (AN). Although the review synthesises evidence of clinical benefit, it does not define, extract, or discuss iatrogenic harm or reasons for dropout. This omission limits what can be inferred from the review’s conclusions.

pmc-13493736.title: Corticosteroid-Associated Adverse Events in Chronic Spontaneous Urticaria: A US Claims Data Study
pmc-13493736.creator: Gil Yosipovitch, Dhaval Patil, Jonathan Rodrigues, Merin Kuruvilla, Tara Raftery, Irina Pivneva, Jason Doran, Arthur Voegel, James Signorovitch, Marc A. Riedl
pmc-13493736.description: IntroductionChronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU) is a skin disorder for which short-course systemic corticosteroids are recommended only as rescue medication during acute exacerbations. Here, we describe real-world corticosteroid use, adverse events (AEs) occurring post-corticosteroid initiation, and health care resource utilization (HCRU) of patients with CSU in the USA.

pmc-13603559.title: ESKAPE Pathogens in a Hungarian Emergency Department: A 5-Year Retrospective Observational Study of Prevalence and Resistance Patterns Utilizing the AWaRe Framework
pmc-13603559.creator: Peter Erdelyi, Ria Benko, Laszlo Papp, Mario Gajdacs, Maria Matuz, Dorottya Gyarfas, Edit Hajdu, Laszlo Orosz, Adam Visnyovszki, Zoltan Peto
pmc-13603559.description: Background/Objectives: Surveillance of local antibiotic resistance plays a critical role in guiding empirical antibiotic therapies in emergency departments (EDs). This study aimed to collect and analyze a five-year period of prevalence and AMR rates among “ESKAPE” pathogens in a tertiary-care ED setting.
